description: Capabilities for the M.U.S.E. main window. Deliberately minimal: the UI talks to the gateway over plain HTTP/fetch, so only core window + tray permissions are granted. No filesystem, shell, or HTTP-plugin scopes are opened. tauri-plugin-shell is registered in Rust but used ONLY from Rust (brain.rs spawns `muse cockpit serve`); deliberately no shell:* permission here, so the webview can never execute processes. The brain's app-defined commands (gateway_status/start/stop, autostart_get/set) are application commands, which Tauri v2 does not ACL-gate.
